purpose: Test whether the fine-tuning delta measured in-distribution (PrimeVul) survives on an unseen source, per docs/REPAIR_EXPERIMENT_PREREGISTRATION.md transfer criteria.

comparison_to_in_distribution.conclusion: fine-tuning delta shrinks by ~3x and loses significance on the unseen source

not_run: held-out nuisance transforms (context size, split-vs-unified, myers-vs-histogram, whitespace)
verdict: The antisymmetric-inference architecture (the projection null) transfers to CrossVul. The fine-tuned increment over that null does NOT clearly transfer: effect shrinks from +0.0267 (p=0.002) in-distribution to +0.0086 (p=0.508) on CrossVul. Do not report the fine-tuning effect as a validated, generalizing repair on this evidence.
